claims: Adrien Brody is a two-time Academy Award winner for Best Actor.
Adrien Brody won the Academy Award for Best Actor for The Brutalist at the 2025 Oscars.
Adrien Brody won the Academy Award for Best Actor for The Pianist in 2002.
Adrien Brody was the youngest winner in the Best Actor category at age 29.
Adrien Brody's 2025 win featured a 5-minute-plus acceptance speech.
Adrien Brody won Best Actor for The Brutalist at the 97th Academy Awards in 2025.
Adrien Brody won Best Actor for The Pianist at the 75th Academy Awards in 2002.
Adrien Brody attended the 98th Academy Awards in 2026 to present after his 2025 win.
